<thought>We need to determine the number of unique hydrogen environments in the compound, but no SMILES or structure is provided. The only way to get information is to call the proton_nmr_spectra tool, which according to its description does not require explicit arguments and may return the spectrum for the current sample. We'll request the spectrum and then infer the number of distinct proton signals.</thought>
<action>proton_nmr_spectra</action>
